scope: 7/9 car exact-result matched complete 3連単 archive 2021-2025, 2026H1

method.candidate: Cartesian actual car subsets of arbitrary size in each finish position; no point cap
method.rank_is_only_intermediate: car ordering by total support across all ordered market prices; never present market-rank codes as purchasable formation
method.favorite_exclusion: skip WHOLE race if proposed complete formation contains exact most popular trifecta
method.discovery: deterministic multistart bit-flip hill climb, NOT exhaustive global optimization
method.starting_conditions: rank-triplet single-bit seeds chosen at random plus random three-slot subsets and all-cars subset
method.train_objective: worst year real whole-formation ROI + weakest year's observed/market residual with minimum support

limitations: Research only, not a purchased system or proven market advantage.
Train best may overfit; hundreds of correlated candidate masks explored.
2024 onward not used to select patterns, but previously seen in other analyses.
Small 5,6,8 car fields not part of this first pass.
One Cartesian formation only; multi-component union research later.
